threads.body: [General] Removing `server.port` makes the Elasticsearch transport inventory omit an attribute still supported for non-default ports. `ElasticsearchTransportAttributesGetter.getServerPort()` supplies the port, and `AbstractElasticsearchTransportClientTest.serverPort()` suppresses it only for port 9300. Make metadata collection exercise a non-default transport port, then regenerate the catalog to retain this attribute.

threads.body: [General] Removing `kafka.consumer.heartbeat_response_time_max` from the default profile while retaining it in both opt-in profiles incorrectly suggests that receive-telemetry flags are required. `AbstractOpenTelemetryMetricsReporterTest.observeMetrics()` still expects this metric, and `KafkaMetricRegistry` does not gate it on those flags. Make default-profile metadata collection capture the metric deterministically, then regenerate the catalog.
